intent: AC-2 GREEN build and Work events ingest fix design
summary: Root cause attributed to work_events_ingest reading every worktree event shard before bailing on failed ref discovery; AC-4 GREEN (6 tests), AC-2 RED confirmed.
progress_summary: Measured in isolated HOME with a counting allocator: RSS 74.8 MB -> 2,243 MB (3 clients) and 67.9 MB -> 1,832 MB (no clients, 3 KB dispatched), so WS snapshot fan-out is not the source. Symbolized sampling put 98% of allocations in work_events_ingest (read_work_event_source). Production gwt.log shows 'ref event batch discovery failed' + 'rebuild deferred' inside both #4234 peak windows: the ingest reads all 282 MB of local shards (243 worktrees) before discovering the failure, then discards them, on every trigger. AC-4 implemented (GUI RSS samples in perf log, memory_pressure recent peak/average; 6 lib tests pass). AC-2 RED confirmed; GREEN patch applied (shared Utf8Bytes payload, snapshot heals every torn client, stale repair dropped, agent snapshot authorized without parsing).
